newsitem.title: TURKEY: Afghan warlord Dostum arrives in Turkish capital.
newsitem.headline: Afghan warlord Dostum arrives in Turkish capital.

text.p: General Abdul Rashid Dostum, ousted from his fiefdom in northern Afghanistan by Islamic Taleban fighters, arrived on Sunday in the Turkish capital Ankara, the Turkish Foreign Ministry said.

"General Abdul Rashid Dostum, leader of the National Islamic Movement who left Afghanistan in the wake of the latest developments in northern Afghanistan, arrived in Ankara aboard a civilian plane early this morning," it said in statement carried by state-run Anatolian news agency.
Witnesses said Dostum arrived with his wife and family.
They said he and his entourage of 16 checked into an Ankara hotel after travelling from the airport in a limousine.
Turkey was widely reported to have supported the ethnic Uzbek leader Dostum, along with Uzbekistan. Turks and Uzbeks share common ethnic and linguistic links.
